integrity: All mathematical assertions are supported by an analytical proof and a standalone finite-check script; finite numerical checks alone do not establish the theorem. Originality is qualified by the possibility of an equivalent classical singular-perturbation formula.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite Fourier masks and fixed arc multiplicity, shrinking equal periodic arcs, continuous noiseless restriction. No uniform growing-bandwidth theorem, angular jitter, phaseless reconstruction, or independent historical priority determination.
title: Exact spectral staircases for periodic narrow-arc Fourier observation
